Mac80211: Checking rssi_threshold for mesh link establishment. This CL compares the received signal strength value of BEACON/PROBE RESPONSE frame with rssi_threshold value, If the received signal value is lesser than rssi_threshold value, then the creation of NEW PEER will be aborted. BUG=b:111676345 TEST=Done with Sanity testing. Tested the logic and observed that the Mesh link has not formed between the PEERs when the received signal strength of BEACON/PROBE RESPONSE frame is lesser than the rssi_threshold value. Change-Id: If72b0fff4ccf6703639426a53a154a7719f7a058 Signed-off-by: Sudharshan <s.sudharshan@globaledgesoftware.corp-partner.google.com> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1165496 Commit-Ready: s.sudharshan s.sudharshan <s.sudharshan@globaledgesoftware.corp-partner.google.com> Tested-by: s.sudharshan s.sudharshan <s.sudharshan@globaledgesoftware.corp-partner.google.com> Reviewed-by: Julan Hsu <julanhsu@chromium.org>

shill: Deprioritize |has_ever_connected| in network sorting This CL moves the 'has ever connected' criteria just above the 'signal strength' and below the 'profile' criteria. This way a never before connected network from user policy/setting will be preferred over a previously connected network from device policy/setting. BUG=chromium:904837 TEST=shill unit test ServiceTest.Compare Change-Id: I3178959913b684256035425d038eaf551287e38c Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1346509 Commit-Ready: Alexander Hendrich <hendrich@chromium.org> Tested-by: Alexander Hendrich <hendrich@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Steven Bennetts <stevenjb@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Ben Chan <benchan@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Kirtika Ruchandani <kirtika@chromium.org>
